definitions.gloss: test kit; testing kit (typically for medical or home diagnostic testing)
definitions.explanation: A packaged set of tools and reagents for carrying out a specific test, especially medical tests done at home or on-site. Became widely familiar to the general public during the COVID-19 pandemic, when self-administered antigen test kits ({抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キット) were sold over the counter.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}キット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Antigen test kits are sold at pharmacies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{検査|けんさ}キット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Since I had a fever, I used a test kit at home to check the result.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ ('test, examination, inspection') + キット (from English 'kit'). Most commonly refers to medical self-test kits: antigen/PCR tests for infectious diseases, pregnancy tests, DNA tests, allergy tests, and the like. Can also refer to industrial or environmental test kits (water quality, soil testing, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キット: antigen test kit
- PCR{検査|けんさ}キット: PCR test kit

- {検査|けんさ}キット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check with a test kit
